description.value: Rusticana Coffee is a café located in Sidney, BC, a compact waterfront town on the Saanich Peninsula that serves as a gateway to the Gulf Islands ferry network and is popular with touring cyclists. The 'Ltd' in its Facebook name suggests an established local business rather than a pop-up or chain outlet. Sidney's walkable downtown core and proximity to the Lochside Regional Trail make cafés here natural rest stops for cyclists arriving or departing via the nearby ferry terminal.
